name: Celadon
desc: Celadon is an Adret NPC. They are one of the disciples required for the Oathless Quest.
additional_info:
-   Celadon's aspect variant is Boulder.
-   He is named after a city in the Kanto region from the _Pokémon_ franchise. Namely, _Celadon City_.
    -   This follows the same pattern with the other Oathless npcs. For more information you can look at [Cerulean](entity:cerulean), [Saffron](entity:saffron), and [Viridian](entity:viridian).
-   Celadon usually means the shade of the color green.
-   Weirdly enough, [Saffron](entity:saffron) has a unique dialogue compared to the other disciples, being "Those eyes... You wish to" and continue. While the others, [Viridian](entity:viridian) and Celadon, saying "Those eyes.. you wish to" and continue.
    -   The only difference these have is that, Saffron has 3 dots and a capitalized Y in "You", while the others have 2 dots and a lower case Y in "you"
